## Deploy Checklist

- [ ] Scope is limited to the intended change.
- [ ] Database migrations are backward-compatible or have a rollback plan.
- [ ] Secrets, OAuth tokens, Vault IDs, and service-role data remain server-side.
- [ ] Public copy avoids absolute compliance claims unless evidence exists.
- [ ] Workflow schema, connector, trigger, or runtime changes have focused tests.
- [ ] Risk, logging, retention, and subprocessor impacts are documented where relevant.

## Verification

- [ ] Type-checks pass.
- [ ] Lint passes.
- [ ] Tests pass.
- [ ] Production build or runtime smoke test completed where applicable.
